title.zh: 授权选举委员会将其拨款中的节余用于建造永久办公大楼的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Commission on Elections to Use Savings from its Appropriations for the Construction of a Permanent Office Building
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Commission on Elections to Use Savings from its Appropriations for the Construction of a Permanent Office Building

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3539_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The provision of any law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Commission on Elections is hereby authorized to use savings from election funds, but in no case to exceed two million five hundred thousand pesos, for the construction of a permanent office building including the necessary accessories, furnishings, and equipment facilities.

This Act shall take upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1963.
